ops.loadingHours: Load-in and load-out of decorations, entertainment equipment and materials by contractors that the client has arranged directly with the hotel's consent, as well as the size, mounting method, location and installation time of signs and the like, are carried out under certain rules that take the hotel's appearance and traffic flow into account, and the hotel gives instructions to the contractors concerned. If the banquet hall usage time (including setup through removal) is exceeded, an additional fee is charged according to the overtime. (Banquet Hall Terms of Use)
ops.parking: The car park is on basement levels 1 and 2 of the hotel, entered from the car porch at the hotel's front entrance. No reservation is required. The height limit is 2.2 m. Overnight guests pay 3,000 yen (tax included) per car per night; restaurant guests get 2 hours free with a spend of 3,000 yen or more. For banquet hall use, show the parking ticket at the banquet hall cloakroom to receive a parking service ticket. Spaces reserved for contract holders cannot be used.
ops.restaurants: On the 2F are Super Dining "Verdure" and Chinese cuisine "CHIKUEN", on the 24F are Japanese cuisine, French cuisine and bar "REN", and on the 1F is the Lobby Lounge "Crystal Movement".
